curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover light rail safety for children on wheels, then how drivers share the road with bicyclists: right-of-way, the passing gap, no honking, dimmed lights and legal swerves.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; a contrast card for riding on the right versus legally moving left.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about passing a bicyclist.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the rules bicyclists follow and the lights and reflectors a bicycle needs at night.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for the two distances, the two limits and required versus optional lights.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about bicycle rules and night equipment.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain why motorcycles are hard to judge and the limits on lane filtering.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each fact; contrast cards for the two lane filtering speeds and the lane rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about lane filtering limits and car and motorcycle crashes.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach how to read a rider's movement and signals and how to pass a motorcycle safely.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; a contrast card for a side move versus a turn.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about intersections and passing motorcycles.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover truck stopping distance, the No-Zone, following distance, wide right turns and breakdowns on the shoulder.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; a contrast card for twice as long versus half the distance.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about driving near large trucks.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach following distance, speeds and wide turns for farm machinery and the slow-moving vehicle symbol.
